SELECT r.year, r.time AS start_time, s.position, s.positionOrder, s.time AS finish_time
FROM main.races AS r
LEFT JOIN main.results AS s ON s.raceId = r.raceId AND s.position IN (1, 2)
WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
ORDER BY r.year, s.position

SELECT r.year AS season_year, s.time AS runner_up_gap
FROM main.races AS r
JOIN main.results AS s ON s.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
  AND s.position = 2
ORDER BY r.time ASC, r.year DESC
LIMIT 1
